owner_recommendation.recommendation: DEFER record curation and owner assignment
owner_recommendation.rationale: The three physical feeds are distinguished, but biological mineralogy and phase fractions are insufficient to map confidently to existing named-phase concentrate owners. Creating another generic enargite-bearing copper concentrate solely for this paper would risk overlapping their scopes. Dose-specific contradictions and unverified two-stage interpretation substantially weaken quantitative admission.
owner_recommendation.edit_option: If primary feed mineralogy establishes an enargite–pyrite or chalcopyrite–enargite assemblage within an existing owner, prefer a qualified source-specific EDIT with independent review; do not change existing experiment identities.
owner_recommendation.create_option: Only if independently characterized material scope is meaningfully distinct from existing mixed concentrates; noCREATEsolelybecauseFujian/anotherDOI/differentdose. Prepared electrode/chemical fractions can remain distinct experiment contexts withoutnewmaterialowners.
owner_recommendation.supported_limited_context: The2.5g/L FeII comparison consistently reports85-day66.8%Cu/8.81%As with inoculum versus49.5%Cu/2.00%As without; Figure5 supports qualitative ordering. This is a conditional mixed-feed inoculum association, not a verified mechanistic gain independent ofpH,isolatedyield or member causation. The10g/LFeII78.3%Cu/12.2%As source endpoints are mutually consistent withinFigure5/prose but do not prove the two-stage process.
owner_recommendation.known_shared_geography: Zijinshan also occurs in previouslycuratedchalcocite work, but geographyalone is notexperiment/batchidentity; no overlap established.
